crew.overview: When the Primm family moves to New York City, their young son Josh struggles to adapt to his new school and new friends. All of that changes when he discovers Lyle — a singing crocodile who loves baths, caviar and great music — living in the attic of his new home. But when Lyle’s existence is threatened by evil neighbor Mr. Grumps, the Primms must band together to show the world that family can come from the most unexpected places.
crew.title: Lyle, Lyle, Crocodile

crew.overview: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.
crew.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

crew.overview: During World War II, the US Army's only all-Black, all-women battalion takes on an impossible mission: sorting through a three-year backlog of 17 million pieces of mail that hadn't been delivered to American soldiers and finish within six months.
crew.title: The Six Triple Eight

details.biography:
Tara Dipetrillo is a makeup artist.

Dipetrillo started getting paid to do makeup when she was 17 years old. Her craft arrived naturally after being a lifelong artist and was tweaked through formal education in spfx makeup.

Growing up pre-internet, Dipetrillo was fascinated by my subscription to Fangoria magazine, Kevin Aucoin books, Disco 2000 club kid fashion, and international vogue.

She attended the School of Visual Arts as a film major. After a year and a half at SVA, she decided to go to school to learn special effects makeup and prosthetics and meld the love of painting and film together.

Dipetrillo is an experienced makeup department head as well as a key makeup artist, spfx makeup artist, and makeup artist.

Atlanta, GA, is her location, where she is a proud member of the I.A.T.S.E. local 798 makeup artists and hairstylists unit.
details.name: Tara DiPetrillo
details.place_of_birth: New York City, New York, U.S.
